rules.description: Level 1. rich-menu/rich-menu.png, preview.svg and image.json exist, and image.json matches the PNG (bytes, sha256).
Level 1. The image is PNG or JPEG, 800-2500px wide, at least 250px high, width/height >= 1.45, at most 1 MB, fully opaque (LINE Messaging API: Requirements for rich menu image).
Level 1. Image size equals menu-config size and design-spec canvas; every tappable area lies inside the image and equals the drawn tile of the same button.
Level 1. Every tile has a label drawn at or above the preset minimum size; label, sub-label (4.5:1) and icon (3:1) contrast pass; the design preset exists.
Level 1. Re-rendering design-spec.json with the current renderer gives the same PNG bytes (sha256) as the delivered image.
Level 1. At most 20 areas; action types are postback, datetimepicker or uri; labels at most 20 characters; postback data at most 300 characters; URIs are https.
Level 1. Every button traces to a LINE action, a selected workflow entry, a pinned action, a generated webhook route and a GAS handler file in the registry.
Level 1. line/deployment.json matches the menu config, image hash and asset versions; it carries no server-issued ids and no secret values.
Level 1. No channel secret, access token, webhook key, GAS web app URL with key, .dev.vars or wrangler secret values anywhere in the project.
Level 1. The webhook topology is LINE -> verification proxy -> GAS; GAS requires WEBHOOK_KEY; every postback the menu can send has a route.
Level 1. line/webhook/ contains the released proxy files byte for byte, its tests, and a wrangler config example that declares secrets by name only.
Level 2. The generated GAS LINE runtime tests (every route: valid input, invalid input, duplicate event, safe error) pass. Needs --run-gas-checks.
Level 3. The proxy tests in line/webhook/ (valid, invalid, missing, modified, wrong secret, empty events) pass. Needs --run-gas-checks.
Level 4. Result of `line-smoke-test` against a real test LINE Official Account, if one was run. Never runs automatically; NOT RUN is reported, not failed.
